title: 替换字符后匹配
summary: 允许按给定字符映射替换 sub 中的字符，判断能否使其匹配 s 的某个连续子串；每个字符可独立选择是否替换。
insight: 预处理 allowed[from][to]。枚举 s 中每个长度足够的起点，逐位检查字符相等或存在从 sub 字符到 s 字符的映射，全部满足即成功。
pitfalls: 映射方向是 sub 原字符到匹配后的字符
同一种映射可使用任意多次
不替换时相同字符总能匹配

solutions.title: 枚举起点与映射表匹配
solutions.idea: 常数时间判断每对字符能否对应。
steps: 建立 allowed[128][128]，对每个 mapping[from,to] 置 true
逐位判断 sub[j]==s[start+j] 或 allowed[sub[j]][s[start+j]]
某个起点全匹配返回 true，否则 false

code.java: class Solution { public boolean matchReplacement(String s,String sub,char[][] mappings){boolean[][] allowed=new boolean[128][128];for(char[] mapping:mappings)allowed[mapping[0]][mapping[1]]=true;for(int start=0;start+sub.length()<=s.length();start++){boolean matches=true;for(int j=0;j<sub.length();j++){char from=sub.charAt(j),to=s.charAt(start+j);if(from!=to&&!allowed[from][to]){matches=false;break;}}if(matches)return true;}return false;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun matchReplacement(s:String,sub:String,mappings:Array<CharArray>):Boolean{val allowed=Array(128){BooleanArray(128)};for(mapping in mappings)allowed[mapping[0].code][mapping[1].code]=true;for(start in 0..s.length-sub.length){var matches=true;for(j in sub.indices){val from=sub[j];val to=s[start+j];if(from!=to&&!allowed[from.code][to.code]){matches=false;break}};if(matches)return true};return false} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:bool matchReplacement(string s,string sub,vector<vector<char>>& mappings){bool allowed[128][128]={};for(auto& mapping:mappings)allowed[mapping[0]][mapping[1]]=true;for(int start=0;start+(int)sub.size()<=(int)s.size();++start){bool matches=true;for(int j=0;j<(int)sub.size();++j){char from=sub[j],to=s[start+j];if(from!=to&&!allowed[from][to]){matches=false;break;}}if(matches)return true;}return false;} };
